newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-CADDICK TO STAY AT SOMERSET.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-CADDICK TO STAY AT SOMERSET.

text.p: England pace bowler Andrew Caddick has put an end to speculation about his future by agreeing a new five-year contract with Somerset.
Caddick, recalled for the winter tour to Zimbabwe and his native New Zealand after two injury-plagued seasons, was already under contract at Taunton for another two years.
But that did not stop speculation about other counties such as Hampshire, Surrey and Glamorgan chasing him, so Somerset are delighted the deal has been renegotiated.
Chief executive Peter Anderson said: "Andrew is a class act. Sorry to disappoint all those other suitors, but a divorce with us would have been totally inappropriate.
"We have been through a lot together and there was never any chance of us allowing him to be lured away."
